(1) 수유부는 섭취를 피할 것

코엔자임Q10엔 탑 항산화 · 높은 혈압 케어Niacin · Manganese · Biotin · Vitamin B1 · Vitamin B12 · Vitamin B2 · Vitamin B6 · Vitamin D · Zinc · Folate · Coenzyme Q10 · Pantothenic acid

Made by 광동헬스바이오(주) 2공장 · Once a day · 1 capsule

This product combines 15mg of Niacin, 3mg of Manganese, 30μg of Biotin, 1.2mg of Vitamin B1, 2.4μg of Vitamin B12, 1.4mg of Vitamin B2, 1.5mg of Vitamin B6, 10μg of Vitamin D, 8.5mg of Zinc, 400μg of Folate, 100mg of Coenzyme Q10, 5mg of Pantothenic acid as labelled amounts. The officially recognised functions of each are listed below.

Why this product

  • Once a day (1 capsule): 15mg Niacin, 3mg Manganese, 30μg Biotin, 1.2mg Vitamin B1, 2.4μg Vitamin B12, 1.4mg Vitamin B2, 1.5mg Vitamin B6, 10μg Vitamin D, 8.5mg Zinc, 400μg Folate, 100mg Coenzyme Q10, 5mg Pantothenic acid
  • Coliform negative — meets its MFDS notified standard
  • Made by 광동헬스바이오(주) 2공장

Officially recognised functions by ingredient

  • Niacin
    • Needed for energy production in the body
  • Manganese
    • Needed for bone formation
    • Needed for energy utilisation
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)
  • Biotin
    • Needed for the metabolism of fat, carbohydrate and protein and for energy production
  • Vitamin B1
    • Needed for carbohydrate and energy metabolism
  • Vitamin B12
    • Needed for normal folate metabolism
  • Vitamin B2
    • Needed for energy production in the body
  • Vitamin B6
    • Needed for protein and amino acid utilisation
    • Needed to help maintain normal blood homocysteine levels
  • Vitamin D
    • Needed for the absorption and utilisation of calcium and phosphorus
    • Needed for the formation and maintenance of bone
    • Recognised as helping reduce the risk of developing osteoporosis
  • Zinc
    • Needed for normal immune function
    • Needed for normal cell division
  • Folate
    • Needed to help maintain normal blood homocysteine levels
    • Needed for cell and blood formation
    • Needed for the normal development of the fetal neural tube
  • Coenzyme Q10
    • May help with antioxidant activity and lowering high blood pressure
  • Pantothenic acid
    • Needed for the metabolism of fat, carbohydrate and protein and for energy production

Directions (exactly as officially stated)

Once a day1 capsule per servingWith water

Labelled standard

Niacin labelled (15mg / 500mg), 80~150%
Manganese labelled (3mg / 500mg), 80~150%
Biotin labelled (30μg / 500mg), 80~180%
Vitamin B1 labelled (1.2mg / 500mg), 80~180%
Vitamin B12 labelled (2.4μg / 500mg), 80~180%
Vitamin B2 labelled (1.4mg / 500mg), 80~180%
Vitamin B6 labelled (1.5mg / 500mg), 80~150%
Vitamin D labelled (10μg / 500mg), 80~180%
Zinc labelled (8.5mg / 500mg), 80~150%
Folate labelled (400μg / 500mg), 80~150%
Coenzyme Q10 labelled (100mg / 500mg), 80~120%
Pantothenic acid labelled (5mg / 500mg), 80~180%
Appearance 고유의 향미가 있고 이미.이취가 없는 주황색의 내용물을 함유한 검정색의 타원형 연질캡슐
Coliform Negative
Shelf life 제조일로부터 24개월
Storage 직사광선을 피하고 서늘한 곳에 보관 및 유통(실온)

Who it suits

  • Those who want to take Niacin · Manganese · Biotin · Vitamin B1 · Vitamin B12 · Vitamin B2 · Vitamin B6 · Vitamin D · Zinc · Folate · Coenzyme Q10 · Pantothenic acid together daily
  • Those who prefer this form
  • Those who want a convenient way to manage multiple nutrients
Precautions · Pregnant or breastfeeding women should consult a professional before use · Consult a professional if you have hypercalcaemia or take medication · Stop use and consult a professional if adverse effects occur · Refer to the official cautions printed on the product

This product combines 7.5mg of Niacin, 1.5mg of Manganese, 15μg of Biotin, 0.6mg of Vitamin B1, 1.2μg of Vitamin B12, 0.7mg of Vitamin B2, 0.75mg of Vitamin B6, 5μg of Vitamin D, 4.25mg of Zinc, 200μg of Folate, 100mg of Coenzyme Q10, 2.5mg of Pantothenic acid as labelled amounts. The officially recognised functions of each are listed below.

Why this product

  • Once a day (1 capsule): 7.5mg Niacin, 1.5mg Manganese, 15μg Biotin, 0.6mg Vitamin B1, 1.2μg Vitamin B12, 0.7mg Vitamin B2, 0.75mg Vitamin B6, 5μg Vitamin D, 4.25mg Zinc, 200μg Folate, 100mg Coenzyme Q10, 2.5mg Pantothenic acid
  • Coliform negative — meets its MFDS notified standard

Officially recognised functions by ingredient

  • Niacin
    • Needed for energy production in the body
  • Manganese
    • Needed for bone formation
    • Needed for energy utilisation
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)
  • Biotin
    • Needed for the metabolism of fat, carbohydrate and protein and for energy production
  • Vitamin B1
    • Needed for carbohydrate and energy metabolism
  • Vitamin B12
    • Needed for normal folate metabolism
  • Vitamin B2
    • Needed for energy production in the body
  • Vitamin B6
    • Needed for protein and amino acid utilisation
    • Needed to help maintain normal blood homocysteine levels
  • Vitamin D
    • Needed for the absorption and utilisation of calcium and phosphorus
    • Needed for the formation and maintenance of bone
    • Recognised as helping reduce the risk of developing osteoporosis
  • Zinc
    • Needed for normal immune function
    • Needed for normal cell division
  • Folate
    • Needed to help maintain normal blood homocysteine levels
    • Needed for cell and blood formation
    • Needed for the normal development of the fetal neural tube
  • Coenzyme Q10
    • May help with antioxidant activity and lowering high blood pressure
  • Pantothenic acid
    • Needed for the metabolism of fat, carbohydrate and protein and for energy production
